requirements.rule: A percentage apprenticeship reduces every fixed allowance whose apprenticeship_pct_relevant flag the data leaves at its default, together with the base salary. Whether the CCNL applies the percentage to that allowance (an EDR, a contingenza, a function allowance) was not sourced. The run is affected when such an allowance is in the apprentice's pay.
requirements.remediation: Source, for each CCNL, the elements the apprenticeship percentage applies to and set apprenticeship_pct_relevant on every allowance; the limitation then no longer applies to its runs.

requirements.rule: Art. 60 c. 7: the employer may replace the patron saint holiday of the travelling staff with 10 hours of paid permits a year, accrued on the day of the holiday; the run pays the patron as a holiday (its coincidence quota included) and does not model the option.
requirements.remediation: Add the employer's election of the 10 hours of art. 60 c. 7 and accrue them in place of the patron holiday.

requirements.rule: NOT MODELLED: the night allowance of art. 16 for a trasferta under 18 hours overlapping the night hours (paid only from 18 hours) and the 4.5 days of paid leave of art. 11 c. 11. The trasferta of art. 62 and the night allowance of a trasferta of 18-24 hours are paid by TravelAllowanceEvent; the 50% on Sunday and holiday work of art. 12 c. 4 by the supplement bands VIAG_DOMENICA and VIAG_FESTIVO.
requirements.remediation: Pay the night allowance of art. 16 and the Sunday or holiday work within the ordinary hours outside the engine.
